title: Quotient equivalence after killing power series variables
statement: For a commutative ring A and i≤d, the quotient of MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A by the ideal generated by variables below i is A-algebra equivalent to MvPowerSeries on the remaining subtype, with the equivalence induced by killCompl.

proof.text: Apply the first isomorphism theorem for surjective algebra homomorphisms to killCompl, rewrite its kernel using the kernel computation, and check the induced map on quotient representatives.

lean.statement: theorem quotient_first_variables_equiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (d i : ℕ) (_hi : i ≤ d) : ∃ e : (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A ⧸ Ideal.span {x : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i ∧ x = X j}) ≃ₐ[A] MvPowerSeries {j : Fin d // i ≤ j.val} A, ∀ f : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ f) = killCompl (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun j : Fin d ↦ i ≤ j.val)) f
